{{nihongo2|フルスト原遺跡}}
''Furusutobaru iseki'' || [[:en:Ishigaki Island|Ishigaki Island]] || [[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki]] || C13-C15 [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]]-style fortifications, domestic buildings, [[utaki]], and tombs extending for 12.3 ha on the {{nihongo|Ryūkyū limestone|[[:ja:琉球石灰岩|琉球石灰岩]]}} hills overlooking Miyara Bay; said to have been used by [[:en:Oyake Akahachi|Oyake Akahachi]] and suppressed by the forces of [[Shō Shin]] in 1500; finds include local pottery, white porcelain and [[:en:Celadon|Celadon]] from China, and the bones of horses and cows{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okinawa.jp/shin-ishigaki/yougo/furusuto.html |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡 |trans-title=Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}}{{cite web |url=http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡の概要 |trans-title=Overview of the Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070502130351/http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |archivedate=2 May 2007 }} || [[File:Ishigaki furusutobaru iseki.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|24.3511203|N|124.19500445|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Furusutobaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3059 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Agena Castle|Agena Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|安慶名城跡}}
''Agena-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]] fortified in the fifteenth century{{cite web |url=http://www.city.uruma.lg.jp/1/209.html |script-title=ja:見どころ：国指定の文化財 |trans-title=Sightseeing Places - Nationally designated Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120502005624/http://www.city.uruma.lg.jp/1/209.html |archivedate=2 May 2012 }} || [[File:Agenagusuku.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.38088963|N|127.85036561|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Agena Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3020 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Iha Shell Mound|Iha Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|伊波貝塚}}
''Iha kaizuka'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site discovered in 1920; finds include shells, fish bones, animal borns, earthenware, stoneware, and goods made of horn{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=139844 |script-title=ja:伊波貝塚 |trans-title=Iha Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || [[File:Iha Shell Mound.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.42047542|N|127.82081653|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Iha Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3018 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Ireibaru|Ireibaru]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:伊礼原遺跡|伊礼原遺跡]]}}
''Ireibaru iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Chatan, Okinawa|Chatan]] || early [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site; goods of [[:en:Jade|Jade]] and [[:en:Obsidian|Obsidian]] are evidence of early maritime trade || || {{coord|26.32434512|N|127.7586994|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Ireibaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003665 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Uegusuku Castle|Uegusuku Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|宇江城城跡}}
''Uegusuku-jō ato'' || [[:en:Kumejima|Kumejima Island]] || [[:en:Kumejima, Okinawa|Kumejima]] || of uncertain date, but probably razed at the time of assimilation into the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] c.1500; finds include Chinese ceramics and fish bones; the view extends over the entire island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=140627 |script-title=ja:宇江城城跡 |trans-title=Uegusuku Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.37696201|N|126.77013595|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uegusuku Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003648 ] |- | align="center"|[[Uzahama Site]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:宇佐浜遺跡|宇佐浜遺跡]]}}
''Uzahama iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Kunigami, Okinawa|Kunigami]] || [[:en:Yayoi period|Yayoi]] site on the northern tip of the island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/db/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=192272 |script-title=ja:宇佐浜遺跡 |trans-title=Uzahama Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20120708014450/http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/db/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=192272 |archivedate=8 July 2012 }} || || {{coord|26.86602391|N|128.26020475|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uzahama Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3016 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Urasoe Castle|Urasoe Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|浦添城跡}}
''Urazoe-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Urasoe, Okinawa|Urasoe]] || fortifications date back to C13/C14; incurred heavy damage during the Battle of Okinawa{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=206923 |script-title=ja:浦添城跡 |trans-title=Urazoe Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Urasoe Castle Walls.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.24648788|N|127.73227642|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Urazoe Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3067 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Enkaku-ji (Okinawa)|Enkaku-ji]] Site
{{nihongo2|円覚寺跡}}
''Enkaku-ji ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Naha, Okinawa|Naha]] || founded in 1492 by [[Shō Shin]]; the wooden temple buildings were destroyed during the war, an ornately carved stone bridge ([[:en:List of Important Cultural Properties of Japan (Okinawa: structures)|ICP]]) survives{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=196300 |script-title=ja:旧円覚寺放生橋 |trans-title=Engaku-ji Hōjō Bridge |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Enkaku-ji(Shuri)200703.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.21832884|N|127.71963726|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Enkakuji Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|3]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3026 ] |- | align="center"|[[Ogidō Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:荻堂貝塚|荻堂貝塚]]}}
''Ogidō kaizuka'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Kitanakagusuku, Okinawa|Kitanakagusuku]] || [[Jōmon period]], with a 1.2 m thick deposit of shells{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=162738 |script-title=ja:荻堂貝塚 |trans-title=Ogidō Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.29323453|N|127.79865309|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Ogidō Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3022 ] |- | align="center"|[[Shimotabaru Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of '''[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]]'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and [[:en:Ryukyu Islands|Islands]] was destroyed during the [[:en:Battle of Okinawa|Battle of Okinawa]]. The mausoleum complex of [[:en:Tamaudun|Tamaudun]], [[Shuri Castle]], [[:en:Katsuren Castle|Katsuren Castle]], [[:en:Nakagusuku Castle|Nakagusuku Castle]], [[:en:Nakijin Castle|Nakijin Castle]], [[:en:Zakimi Castle|Zakimi Castle]], [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]] all form part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu]].{{cite web |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/972/ |title=Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |accessdate=24 September 2017}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of '''[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]]'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and [[:en:Ryukyu Islands|Islands]] was destroyed during the [[:en:Battle of Okinawa|Battle of Okinawa]]. The mausoleum complex of [[:en:Tamaudun|Tamaudun]], [[Shuri Castle]], [[:en:Katsuren Castle|Katsuren Castle]], [[:en:Nakagusuku Castle|Nakagusuku Castle]], [[:en:Nakijin Castle|Nakijin Castle]], [[:en:Zakimi Castle|Zakimi Castle]], [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]] all form part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu]].{{cite web |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/972/ |title=Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |accessdate=24 September 2017}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 October 2024, forty-three Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 October 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 沖縄県) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.okinawa.jp/kyoiku/edu/1008462/1008471/1028479.html |script-title=ja:国・県・市町村指定文化財 |trans-title=National, Prefectural, and Municipal Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |date=1 May 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="20%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Island !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|[[:en:Furusutobaru Castle|Furusutobaru Castle]]
{{nihongo2|フルスト原遺跡}}
''Furusutobaru iseki'' || [[:en:Ishigaki Island|Ishigaki Island]] || [[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki]] || C13-C15 [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]]-style fortifications, domestic buildings, [[utaki]], and tombs extending for 12.3 ha on the {{nihongo|Ryūkyū limestone|[[:ja:琉球石灰岩|琉球石灰岩]]}} hills overlooking Miyara Bay; said to have been used by [[:en:Oyake Akahachi|Oyake Akahachi]] and suppressed by the forces of [[Shō Shin]] in 1500; finds include local pottery, white porcelain and [[:en:Celadon|Celadon]] from China, and the bones of horses and cows{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okinawa.jp/shin-ishigaki/yougo/furusuto.html |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡 |trans-title=Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}}{{cite web |url=http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡の概要 |trans-title=Overview of the Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070502130351/http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |archivedate=2 May 2007 }} || [[File:Ishigaki furusutobaru iseki.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|24.3511203|N|124.19500445|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Furusutobaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3059 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Agena Castle|Agena Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|安慶名城跡}}
''Agena-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]] fortified in the fifteenth century{{cite web |url=http://www.city.uruma.lg.jp/1/209.html |script-title=ja:見どころ：国指定の文化財 |trans-title=Sightseeing Places - Nationally designated Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120502005624/http://www.city.uruma.lg.jp/1/209.html |archivedate=2 May 2012 }} || [[File:Agenagusuku.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.38088963|N|127.85036561|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Agena Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3020 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Iha Shell Mound|Iha Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|伊波貝塚}}
''Iha kaizuka'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site discovered in 1920; finds include shells, fish bones, animal borns, earthenware, stoneware, and goods made of horn{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=139844 |script-title=ja:伊波貝塚 |trans-title=Iha Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || [[File:Iha Shell Mound.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.42047542|N|127.82081653|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Iha Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3018 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Ireibaru|Ireibaru]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:伊礼原遺跡|伊礼原遺跡]]}}
''Ireibaru iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Chatan, Okinawa|Chatan]] || early [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site; goods of [[:en:Jade|Jade]] and [[:en:Obsidian|Obsidian]] are evidence of early maritime trade || || {{coord|26.32434512|N|127.7586994|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Ireibaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003665 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Uegusuku Castle|Uegusuku Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|宇江城城跡}}
''Uegusuku-jō ato'' || [[:en:Kumejima|Kumejima Island]] || [[:en:Kumejima, Okinawa|Kumejima]] || of uncertain date, but probably razed at the time of assimilation into the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] c.1500; finds include Chinese ceramics and fish bones; the view extends over the entire island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=140627 |script-title=ja:宇江城城跡 |trans-title=Uegusuku Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.37696201|N|126.77013595|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uegusuku Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003648 ] |- | align="center"|[[Uzahama Site]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:宇佐浜遺跡|宇佐浜遺跡]]}}
''Uzahama iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Kunigami, Okinawa|Kunigami]] || [[:en:Yayoi period|Yayoi]] site on the northern tip of the island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/db/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=192272 |script-title=ja:宇佐浜遺跡 |trans-title=Uzahama Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20120708014450/http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/db/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=192272 |archivedate=8 July 2012 }} || || {{coord|26.86602391|N|128.26020475|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uzahama Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3016 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Urasoe Castle|Urasoe Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|浦添城跡}}
''Urazoe-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Urasoe, Okinawa|Urasoe]] || fortifications date back to C13/C14; incurred heavy damage during the Battle of Okinawa{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=206923 |script-title=ja:浦添城跡 |trans-title=Urazoe Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Urasoe Castle Walls.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.24648788|N|127.73227642|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Urazoe Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3067 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Enkaku-ji (Okinawa)|Enkaku-ji]] Site
{{nihongo2|円覚寺跡}}
''Enkaku-ji ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Naha, Okinawa|Naha]] || founded in 1492 by [[Shō Shin]]; the wooden temple buildings were destroyed during the war, an ornately carved stone bridge ([[:en:List of Important Cultural Properties of Japan (Okinawa: structures)|ICP]]) survives{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=196300 |script-title=ja:旧円覚寺放生橋 |trans-title=Engaku-ji Hōjō Bridge |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Enkaku-ji(Shuri)200703.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.21832884|N|127.71963726|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Enkakuji Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|3]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3026 ] |- | align="center"|[[Ogidō Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:荻堂貝塚|荻堂貝塚]]}}

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of '''[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]]'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and [[:en:Ryukyu Islands|Islands]] was destroyed during the [[:en:Battle of Okinawa|Battle of Okinawa]]. The mausoleum complex of [[:en:Tamaudun|Tamaudun]], [[Shuri Castle]], [[:en:Katsuren Castle|Katsuren Castle]], [[:en:Nakagusuku Castle|Nakagusuku Castle]], [[:en:Nakijin Castle|Nakijin Castle]], [[:en:Zakimi Castle|Zakimi Castle]], [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]] all form part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu]].{{cite web |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/972/ |title=Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |accessdate=24 September 2017}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 October 2024, forty-three Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 October 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 沖縄県) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.okinawa.jp/kyoiku/edu/1008462/1008471/1028479.html |script-title=ja:国・県・市町村指定文化財 |trans-title=National, Prefectural, and Municipal Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |date=1 May 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="20%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Island !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|[[:en:Furusutobaru Castle|Furusutobaru Castle]]
{{nihongo2|フルスト原遺跡}}
''Furusutobaru iseki'' || [[:en:Ishigaki Island|Ishigaki Island]] || [[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki]] || C13-C15 [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]]-style fortifications, domestic buildings, [[utaki]], and tombs extending for 12.3 ha on the {{nihongo|Ryūkyū limestone|[[:ja:琉球石灰岩|琉球石灰岩]]}} hills overlooking Miyara Bay; said to have been used by [[:en:Oyake Akahachi|Oyake Akahachi]] and suppressed by the forces of [[Shō Shin]] in 1500; finds include local pottery, white porcelain and [[:en:Celadon|Celadon]] from China, and the bones of horses and cows{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okinawa.jp/shin-ishigaki/yougo/furusuto.html |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡 |trans-title=Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}}{{cite web |url=http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡の概要 |trans-title=Overview of the Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070502130351/http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |archivedate=2 May 2007 }} || [[File:Ishigaki furusutobaru iseki.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|24.3511203|N|124.19500445|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Furusutobaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3059 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Agena Castle|Agena Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|安慶名城跡}}
''Agena-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]] fortified in the fifteenth century{{cite web |url=http://www.city.uruma.lg.jp/1/209.html |script-title=ja:見どころ：国指定の文化財 |trans-title=Sightseeing Places - Nationally designated Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120502005624/http://www.city.uruma.lg.jp/1/209.html |archivedate=2 May 2012 }} || [[File:Agenagusuku.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.38088963|N|127.85036561|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Agena Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3020 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Iha Shell Mound|Iha Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|伊波貝塚}}
''Iha kaizuka'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site discovered in 1920; finds include shells, fish bones, animal borns, earthenware, stoneware, and goods made of horn{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=139844 |script-title=ja:伊波貝塚 |trans-title=Iha Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || [[File:Iha Shell Mound.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.42047542|N|127.82081653|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Iha Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3018 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Ireibaru|Ireibaru]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:伊礼原遺跡|伊礼原遺跡]]}}
''Ireibaru iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Chatan, Okinawa|Chatan]] || early [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site; goods of [[:en:Jade|Jade]] and [[:en:Obsidian|Obsidian]] are evidence of early maritime trade || || {{coord|26.32434512|N|127.7586994|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Ireibaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003665 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Uegusuku Castle|Uegusuku Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|宇江城城跡}}
''Uegusuku-jō ato'' || [[:en:Kumejima|Kumejima Island]] || [[:en:Kumejima, Okinawa|Kumejima]] || of uncertain date, but probably razed at the time of assimilation into the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] c.1500; finds include Chinese ceramics and fish bones; the view extends over the entire island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=140627 |script-title=ja:宇江城城跡 |trans-title=Uegusuku Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.37696201|N|126.77013595|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uegusuku Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003648 ] |- | align="center"|[[Uzahama Site]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:宇佐浜遺跡|宇佐浜遺跡]]}}
''Uzahama iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Kunigami, Okinawa|Kunigami]] || [[:en:Yayoi period|Yayoi]] site on the northern tip of the island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/db/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=192272 |script-title=ja:宇佐浜遺跡 |trans-title=Uzahama Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20120708014450/http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/db/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=192272 |archivedate=8 July 2012 }} || || {{coord|26.86602391|N|128.26020475|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uzahama Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3016 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Urasoe Castle|Urasoe Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|浦添城跡}}
''Urazoe-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Urasoe, Okinawa|Urasoe]] || fortifications date back to C13/C14; incurred heavy damage during the Battle of Okinawa{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=206923 |script-title=ja:浦添城跡 |trans-title=Urazoe Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Urasoe Castle Walls.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.24648788|N|127.73227642|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Urazoe Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3067 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Enkaku-ji (Okinawa)|Enkaku-ji]] Site
{{nihongo2|円覚寺跡}}
''Enkaku-ji ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Naha, Okinawa|Naha]] || founded in 1492 by [[Shō Shin]]; the wooden temple buildings were destroyed during the war, an ornately carved stone bridge ([[:en:List of Important Cultural Properties of Japan (Okinawa: structures)|ICP]]) survives{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=196300 |script-title=ja:旧円覚寺放生橋 |trans-title=Engaku-ji Hōjō Bridge |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Enkaku-ji(Shuri)200703.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.21832884|N|127.71963726|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Enkakuji Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|3]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3026 ] |- | align="center"|[[Ogidō Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:荻堂貝塚|荻堂貝塚]]}}
''Ogidō kaizuka'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Kitanakagusuku, Okinawa|Kitanakagusuku]] || [[Jōmon period]], with a 1.2 m thick deposit of shells{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=162738 |script-title=ja:荻堂貝塚 |trans-title=Ogidō Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.29323453|N|127.79865309|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Ogidō Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3022 ] |- | align="center"|[[Shimotabaru Castle]] Site

''Shimotabaru-jō ato'' || [[:en:Hateruma|Hateruma Island]] || [[:en:Taketomi, Okinawa|Taketomi]] || || [[File:2016-02-26 Shimotabaru-jou,Hateruma 下田原城・ぶりぶち公園 波照間島 DSCF2525.JPG|150px]] || {{coord|24.06934384|N|123.77915508|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Shimotabaru Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3366 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Tamagusuku Castle|Tamagusuku Castle]] Site

{{nihongo2|玉陵}}
''Tamaudun'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Naha, Okinawa|Naha]] || royal mausoleum complex constructed in 1501; [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu|World Heritage Site]] || [[File:Tamaudun03bs3200.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.21831078|N|127.71465507|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Tamaudūn}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|7]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3027 ] |- | align="center"|[[Kushibaru Shell Mound]]

''Gushikawa-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Itoman, Okinawa|Itoman]] || C13-C15 Chinese ceramics found during excavations; thirteen-year restoration project between 2000 and 2012{{cite web |url=http://www.city.itoman.okinawa.jp/kyouiku_bunka/bunkazai/old/gushikawajyouseki/gusikawajyosekihozonjigyo.htm |script-title=ja:具志川城跡保存修理事業 |trans-title=Restoration of Gushikawa Castle |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Itoman, Okinawa|Itoman City]] |accessdate=31 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20120729141700/http://www.city.itoman.okinawa.jp/kyouiku_bunka/bunkazai/old/gushikawajyouseki/gusikawajyosekihozonjigyo.htm |archivedate=29 July 2012 }} || [[File:Historic sites of Gushikawa Castle 01 at Itoman city.JPG|150px]] || {{coord|26.08027649|N|127.66431713|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Gushikawa Castle Site (Itoman)}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3032 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Gushikawa Castle (Kume)|Gushikawa Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|具志川城跡}}
''Gushikawa-jō ato'' || [[:en:Kumejima Island|Kumejima Island]] || [[:en:Kumejima, Okinawa|Kumejima]] || same name but distinct from the castle in Itoman || || {{coord|26.38470951|N|126.75190674|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Gushikawa Castle (Kumejima)}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3057 ] |- | align="center"|[[Kunigami Hōsei Kaidō]]

''Nakijin-jō ato tsuketari Shiina-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Nakijin, Okinawa|Nakijin]] || sacked in 1432; [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu|World Heritage Site]]; designation includes the site of {{nihongo|Shiina Castle|シイナ城}}{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=206873 |script-title=ja:今帰仁城跡 附シイナ城跡 |trans-title=Nakijin Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Nakijinjyousi.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.69108846|N|127.92975556|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Nakijin Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3017 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Zakimi Castle|Zakimi Castle]] Site

''Zakimi-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Yomitan, Okinawa|Yomitan]] || constructed c. 1420 by [[:en:Gosamaru|Gosamaru]]; [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu|World Heritage Site]]{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=173575 |script-title=ja:座喜味城跡 |trans-title=Zakimi Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 June 2012}} || [[File:Zakimi Eingang.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.40840356|N|127.74176086|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Zakimi Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3019 ] |- | align="center"|[[Sefa-utaki]]
{{nihongo2|斎場御嶽}}
''Seifa-utaki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Nanjō, Okinawa|Nanjō]] || shrine; excavated artefacts including [[magatama]] are an [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|ICP]]; [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu|World Heritage Site]]{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=207440 |script-title=ja:沖縄県斎場御嶽出土品 |trans-title=Items excavated from Seifā Utaki (Okinawa Prefecture) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 June 2012}} || [[File:Seifautaki Okinawa Japan 沖縄 斎場御嶽 - panoramio (4).jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.17325543|N|127.82717685|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Seifā Utaki}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|3]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3029 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Yamada Castle|Yamada Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|山田城跡}}
''Yamada-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Onna, Okinawa|Onna]] || Home of [[:en:Gosamaru|Gosamaru]]. {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of '''[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]]'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and [[:en:Ryukyu Islands|Islands]] was destroyed during the [[:en:Battle of Okinawa|Battle of Okinawa]]. The mausoleum complex of [[:en:Tamaudun|Tamaudun]], [[Shuri Castle]], [[:en:Katsuren Castle|Katsuren Castle]], [[:en:Nakagusuku Castle|Nakagusuku Castle]], [[:en:Nakijin Castle|Nakijin Castle]], [[:en:Zakimi Castle|Zakimi Castle]], [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]] all form part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu]].{{cite web |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/972/ |title=Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |accessdate=24 September 2017}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 October 2024, forty-three Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 October 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 沖縄県) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.okinawa.jp/kyoiku/edu/1008462/1008471/1028479.html |script-title=ja:国・県・市町村指定文化財 |trans-title=National, Prefectural, and Municipal Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |date=1 May 2024 {{nihongo2|フルスト原遺跡}}
''Furusutobaru iseki'' || [[:en:Ishigaki Island|Ishigaki Island]] || [[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki]] || C13-C15 [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]]-style fortifications, domestic buildings, [[utaki]], and tombs extending for 12.3 ha on the {{nihongo|Ryūkyū limestone|[[:ja:琉球石灰岩|琉球石灰岩]]}} hills overlooking Miyara Bay; said to have been used by [[:en:Oyake Akahachi|Oyake Akahachi]] and suppressed by the forces of [[Shō Shin]] in 1500; finds include local pottery, white porcelain and [[:en:Celadon|Celadon]] from China, and the bones of horses and cows{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okinawa.jp/shin-ishigaki/yougo/furusuto.html |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡 |trans-title=Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}}{{cite web |url=http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡の概要 |trans-title=Overview of the Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070502130351/http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |archivedate=2 May 2007 }} || [[File:Ishigaki furusutobaru iseki.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|24.3511203|N|124.19500445|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Furusutobaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3059 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Agena Castle|Agena Castle]] Site

''Iha kaizuka'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site discovered in 1920; finds include shells, fish bones, animal borns, earthenware, stoneware, and goods made of horn{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=139844 |script-title=ja:伊波貝塚 |trans-title=Iha Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || [[File:Iha Shell Mound.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.42047542|N|127.82081653|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Iha Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3018 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Ireibaru|Ireibaru]]

''Ireibaru iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Chatan, Okinawa|Chatan]] || early [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site; goods of [[:en:Jade|Jade]] and [[:en:Obsidian|Obsidian]] are evidence of early maritime trade || || {{coord|26.32434512|N|127.7586994|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Ireibaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003665 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Uegusuku Castle|Uegusuku Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|宇江城城跡}}
''Uegusuku-jō ato'' || [[:en:Kumejima|Kumejima Island]] || [[:en:Kumejima, Okinawa|Kumejima]] || of uncertain date, but probably razed at the time of assimilation into the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] c.1500; finds include Chinese ceramics and fish bones; the view extends over the entire island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=140627 |script-title=ja:宇江城城跡 |trans-title=Uegusuku Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.37696201|N|126.77013595|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uegusuku Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003648 ] |- | align="center"|[[Uzahama Site]]

''Tarama Jinja'' || [[:en:Tarama Island|Tarama Island]] || [[:en:Tarama, Okinawa|Tarama]] || || || {{coord|24.670737|N|124.700142|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Tarama Jinja}} || || |- |} ==Registered Historic Sites== As of 1 October 2024, two Monuments have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan#categories of registered Cultural Properties|registered]] (as opposed to [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]]) as Historic Sites at a national level.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:登録文化財 |trans-title=Number of Registered Cultural Properties by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 October 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 登録記念物 (遺跡関係 沖縄県) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="20%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Island !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|[[:en:Okinawa Prefectural Railways|Okinawa Prefectural Railways]] [[Yonabaru Station]] Site
{{nihongo2|沖縄県鉄道[[:ja:与那原駅|与那原駅]]跡}}
''Okinawa-ken tetsudō Yonabaru-eki ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Yonabaru, Okinawa|Yonabaru]] || || [[File:Yonabaru Station of Okinawa Prefectural Railways.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.19958|N|127.75480|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Okinawa Prefectural Railways Yonabaru Station Site}} || || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/411/00004009 ] |- | align="center"|[[Heshikiya Sugar Refining Site]]

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of '''[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]]'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and [[:en:Ryukyu Islands|Islands]] was destroyed during the [[:en:Battle of Okinawa|Battle of Okinawa]]. The mausoleum complex of [[:en:Tamaudun|Tamaudun]], [[Shuri Castle]], [[:en:Katsuren Castle|Katsuren Castle]], [[:en:Nakagusuku Castle|Nakagusuku Castle]], [[:en:Nakijin Castle|Nakijin Castle]], [[:en:Zakimi Castle|Zakimi Castle]], [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]] all form part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu]].{{cite web |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/972/ |title=Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |accessdate=24 September 2017}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 October 2024, forty-three Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 October 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 沖縄県) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.okinawa.jp/kyoiku/edu/1008462/1008471/1028479.html |script-title=ja:国・県・市町村指定文化財 |trans-title=National, Prefectural, and Municipal Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |date=1 May 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="20%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Island !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|[[:en:Furusutobaru Castle|Furusutobaru Castle]]
{{nihongo2|フルスト原遺跡}}
''Furusutobaru iseki'' || [[:en:Ishigaki Island|Ishigaki Island]] || [[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki]] || C13-C15 [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]]-style fortifications, domestic buildings, [[utaki]], and tombs extending for 12.3 ha on the {{nihongo|Ryūkyū limestone|[[:ja:琉球石灰岩|琉球石灰岩]]}} hills overlooking Miyara Bay; said to have been used by [[:en:Oyake Akahachi|Oyake Akahachi]] and suppressed by the forces of [[Shō Shin]] in 1500; finds include local pottery, white porcelain and [[:en:Celadon|Celadon]] from China, and the bones of horses and cows{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okinawa.jp/shin-ishigaki/yougo/furusuto.html |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡 |trans-title=Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}}{{cite web |url=http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡の概要 |trans-title=Overview of the Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070502130351/http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |archivedate=2 May 2007 }} || [[File:Ishigaki furusutobaru iseki.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|24.3511203|N|124.19500445|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Furusutobaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3059 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Agena Castle|Agena Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|安慶名城跡}}
''Agena-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]] fortified in the fifteenth century{{cite web |url=http://www.city.uruma.lg.jp/1/209.html |script-title=ja:見どころ：国指定の文化財 |trans-title=Sightseeing Places - Nationally designated Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120502005624/http://www.city.uruma.lg.jp/1/209.html |archivedate=2 May 2012 }} || [[File:Agenagusuku.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.38088963|N|127.85036561|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Agena Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3020 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Iha Shell Mound|Iha Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|伊波貝塚}}
''Iha kaizuka'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site discovered in 1920; finds include shells, fish bones, animal borns, earthenware, stoneware, and goods made of horn{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=139844 |script-title=ja:伊波貝塚 |trans-title=Iha Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || [[File:Iha Shell Mound.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.42047542|N|127.82081653|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Iha Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3018 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Ireibaru|Ireibaru]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:伊礼原遺跡|伊礼原遺跡]]}}
''Ireibaru iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Chatan, Okinawa|Chatan]] || early [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site; goods of [[:en:Jade|Jade]] and [[:en:Obsidian|Obsidian]] are evidence of early maritime trade || || {{coord|26.32434512|N|127.7586994|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Ireibaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003665 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Uegusuku Castle|Uegusuku Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|宇江城城跡}}
''Uegusuku-jō ato'' || [[:en:Kumejima|Kumejima Island]] || [[:en:Kumejima, Okinawa|Kumejima]] || of uncertain date, but probably razed at the time of assimilation into the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] c.1500; finds include Chinese ceramics and fish bones; the view extends over the entire island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=140627 |script-title=ja:宇江城城跡 |trans-title=Uegusuku Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.37696201|N|126.77013595|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uegusuku Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003648 ] |- | align="center"|[[Uzahama Site]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:宇佐浜遺跡|宇佐浜遺跡]]}}
''Uzahama iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Kunigami, Okinawa|Kunigami]] || [[:en:Yayoi period|Yayoi]] site on the northern tip of the island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/db/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=192272 |script-title=ja:宇佐浜遺跡 |trans-title=Uzahama Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20120708014450/http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/db/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=192272 |archivedate=8 July 2012 }} || || {{coord|26.86602391|N|128.26020475|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uzahama Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3016 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Urasoe Castle|Urasoe Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|浦添城跡}}
''Urazoe-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Urasoe, Okinawa|Urasoe]] || fortifications date back to C13/C14; incurred heavy damage during the Battle of Okinawa{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=206923 |script-title=ja:浦添城跡 |trans-title=Urazoe Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Urasoe Castle Walls.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.24648788|N|127.73227642|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Urazoe Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3067 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Enkaku-ji (Okinawa)|Enkaku-ji]] Site
{{nihongo2|円覚寺跡}}
''Enkaku-ji ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Naha, Okinawa|Naha]] || founded in 1492 by [[Shō Shin]]; the wooden temple buildings were destroyed during the war, an ornately carved stone bridge ([[:en:List of Important Cultural Properties of Japan (Okinawa: structures)|ICP]]) survives{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=196300 |script-title=ja:旧円覚寺放生橋 |trans-title=Engaku-ji Hōjō Bridge |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Enkaku-ji(Shuri)200703.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.21832884|N|127.71963726|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Enkakuji Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|3]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3026 ] |- | align="center"|[[Ogidō Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:荻堂貝塚|荻堂貝塚]]}}
''Ogidō kaizuka'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Kitanakagusuku, Okinawa|Kitanakagusuku]] || [[Jōmon period]], with a 1.2 m thick deposit of shells{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=162738 |script-title=ja:荻堂貝塚 |trans-title=Ogidō Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.29323453|N|127.79865309|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Ogidō Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3022 ] |- | align="center"|[[Shimotabaru Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:下田原城|下田原城]]跡}}
''Shimotabaru-jō ato'' || [[:en:Hateruma|Hateruma Island]] || [[:en:Taketomi, Okinawa|Taketomi]] || || [[File:2016-02-26 Shimotabaru-jou,Hateruma 下田原城・ぶりぶち公園 波照間島 DSCF2525.JPG|150px]] || {{coord|24.06934384|N|123.77915508|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Shimotabaru Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3366 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Tamagusuku Castle|Tamagusuku Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|玉城城跡}}
''Tamagusuku-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Nanjō, Okinawa|Nanjō]] || || [[File:Tamagusuku arch.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.1441253|N|127.78067218|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Tamagusuku Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3066 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Tamaudun|Tamaudun]]
{{nihongo2|玉陵}}
''Tamaudun'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Naha, Okinawa|Naha]] || royal mausoleum complex constructed in 1501; [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu|World Heritage Site]] || [[File:Tamaudun03bs3200.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.21831078|N|127.71465507|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Tamaudūn}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|7]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3027 ] |- | align="center"|[[Kushibaru Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|具志原貝塚}}
''Kushibaru kaizuka'' || [[:en:Iejima|Ie Island]] || [[:en:Ie, Okinawa|Ie]] || variety of shells and [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] and [[:en:Yayoi period|Yayoi]] earthenware{{cite web |url=http://www.iejima.org/ieson/index.php?oid=42&dtype=1000&pid=100 |script-title=ja:具志原貝塚 |trans-title=Kushibaru Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Ie, Okinawa|Ie Village]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.7083557|N|127.80085456|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Kushibaru Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3063 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Gushikawa Castle (Itoman)|Gushikawa Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|具志川城跡}}
''Gushikawa-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Itoman, Okinawa|Itoman]] || C13-C15 Chinese ceramics found during excavations; thirteen-year restoration project between 2000 and 2012{{cite web |url=http://www.city.itoman.okinawa.jp/kyouiku_bunka/bunkazai/old/gushikawajyouseki/gusikawajyosekihozonjigyo.htm |script-title=ja:具志川城跡保存修理事業 |trans-title=Restoration of Gushikawa Castle |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Itoman, Okinawa|Itoman City]] |accessdate=31 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20120729141700/http://www.city.itoman.okinawa.jp/kyouiku_bunka/bunkazai/old/gushikawajyouseki/gusikawajyosekihozonjigyo.htm |archivedate=29 July 2012 }} || [[File:Historic sites of Gushikawa Castle 01 at Itoman city.JPG|150px]] || {{coord|26.08027649|N|127.66431713|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Gushikawa Castle Site (Itoman)}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3032 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Gushikawa Castle (Kume)|Gushikawa Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|具志川城跡}}
''Gushikawa-jō ato'' || [[:en:Kumejima Island|Kumejima Island]] || [[:en:Kumejima, Okinawa|Kumejima]] || same name but distinct from the castle in Itoman || || {{coord|26.38470951|N|126.75190674|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Gushikawa Castle (Kumejima)}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3057 ] |- | align="center"|[[Kunigami Hōsei Kaidō]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:国頭方西海道|国頭方西海道]]}}
''Kunigami hōsei kaidō'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Onna, Okinawa|Onna]] || historic route on the west coast of the island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=207233 |script-title=ja:国頭方西海道 |trans-title=Kunigami Hōsei Kaidō |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.43476258|N|127.78981966|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Kunigamihōseikaidō}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|6]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3412 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Nakijin Castle|Nakijin Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|今帰仁城跡 附シイナ城跡}}

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of '''[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]]'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and [[:en:Ryukyu Islands|Islands]] was destroyed during the [[:en:Battle of Okinawa|Battle of Okinawa]]. The mausoleum complex of [[:en:Tamaudun|Tamaudun]], [[Shuri Castle]], [[:en:Katsuren Castle|Katsuren Castle]], [[:en:Nakagusuku Castle|Nakagusuku Castle]], [[:en:Nakijin Castle|Nakijin Castle]], [[:en:Zakimi Castle|Zakimi Castle]], [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]] all form part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu]].{{cite web |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/972/ |title=Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |accessdate=24 September 2017}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 October 2024, forty-three Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 October 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 沖縄県) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.okinawa.jp/kyoiku/edu/1008462/1008471/1028479.html |script-title=ja:国・県・市町村指定文化財 |trans-title=National, Prefectural, and Municipal Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |date=1 May 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="20%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Island !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality ''Furusutobaru iseki'' || [[:en:Ishigaki Island|Ishigaki Island]] || [[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki]] || C13-C15 [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]]-style fortifications, domestic buildings, [[utaki]], and tombs extending for 12.3 ha on the {{nihongo|Ryūkyū limestone|[[:ja:琉球石灰岩|琉球石灰岩]]}} hills overlooking Miyara Bay; said to have been used by [[:en:Oyake Akahachi|Oyake Akahachi]] and suppressed by the forces of [[Shō Shin]] in 1500; finds include local pottery, white porcelain and [[:en:Celadon|Celadon]] from China, and the bones of horses and cows{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okinawa.jp/shin-ishigaki/yougo/furusuto.html |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡 |trans-title=Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}}{{cite web |url=http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡の概要 |trans-title=Overview of the Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070502130351/http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |archivedate=2 May 2007 }} || [[File:Ishigaki furusutobaru iseki.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|24.3511203|N|124.19500445|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Furusutobaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3059 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Agena Castle|Agena Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of '''[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]]'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and [[:en:Ryukyu Islands|Islands]] was destroyed during the [[:en:Battle of Okinawa|Battle of Okinawa]]. The mausoleum complex of [[:en:Tamaudun|Tamaudun]], [[:en:Shuri Castle|Shuri Castle]], [[:en:Katsuren Castle|Katsuren Castle]], [[:en:Nakagusuku Castle|Nakagusuku Castle]], [[:en:Nakijin Castle|Nakijin Castle]], [[:en:Zakimi Castle|Zakimi Castle]], [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]] all form part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu]].{{cite web |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/972/ |title=Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |accessdate=24 September 2017}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 October 2024, forty-three Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 October 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 沖縄県) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.okinawa.jp/kyoiku/edu/1008462/1008471/1028479.html |script-title=ja:国・県・市町村指定文化財 |trans-title=National, Prefectural, and Municipal Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |date=1 May 2024 {{nihongo2|フルスト原遺跡}}
''Furusutobaru iseki'' || [[:en:Ishigaki Island|Ishigaki Island]] || [[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki]] || C13-C15 [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]]-style fortifications, domestic buildings, [[utaki]], and tombs extending for 12.3 ha on the {{nihongo|Ryūkyū limestone|[[:ja:琉球石灰岩|琉球石灰岩]]}} hills overlooking Miyara Bay; said to have been used by [[:en:Oyake Akahachi|Oyake Akahachi]] and suppressed by the forces of [[Shō Shin]] in 1500; finds include local pottery, white porcelain and [[:en:Celadon|Celadon]] from China, and the bones of horses and cows{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okinawa.jp/shin-ishigaki/yougo/furusuto.html |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡 |trans-title=Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}}{{cite web |url=http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡の概要 |trans-title=Overview of the Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Ishigaki, Okinawa|Ishigaki City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070502130351/http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |archivedate=2 May 2007 }} || [[File:Ishigaki furusutobaru iseki.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|24.3511203|N|124.19500445|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Furusutobaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3059 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Agena Castle|Agena Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|安慶名城跡}}
''Agena-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[:en:Gusuku|Gusuku]] fortified in the fifteenth century{{cite web |url=http://www.city.uruma.lg.jp/1/209.html |script-title=ja:見どころ：国指定の文化財 |trans-title=Sightseeing Places - Nationally designated Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma City]] |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120502005624/http://www.city.uruma.lg.jp/1/209.html |archivedate=2 May 2012 }} || [[File:Agenagusuku.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.38088963|N|127.85036561|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Agena Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3020 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Iha Shell Mound|Iha Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|伊波貝塚}}
''Iha kaizuka'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Uruma, Okinawa|Uruma]] || [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site discovered in 1920; finds include shells, fish bones, animal borns, earthenware, stoneware, and goods made of horn{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=139844 |script-title=ja:伊波貝塚 |trans-title=Iha Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || [[File:Iha Shell Mound.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.42047542|N|127.82081653|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Iha Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3018 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Ireibaru|Ireibaru]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:伊礼原遺跡|伊礼原遺跡]]}}
''Ireibaru iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Chatan, Okinawa|Chatan]] || early [[Jōmon period|Jōmon]] site; goods of [[:en:Jade|Jade]] and [[:en:Obsidian|Obsidian]] are evidence of early maritime trade || || {{coord|26.32434512|N|127.7586994|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Ireibaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003665 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Uegusuku Castle|Uegusuku Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|宇江城城跡}}
''Uegusuku-jō ato'' || [[:en:Kumejima|Kumejima Island]] || [[:en:Kumejima, Okinawa|Kumejima]] || of uncertain date, but probably razed at the time of assimilation into the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] c.1500; finds include Chinese ceramics and fish bones; the view extends over the entire island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=140627 |script-title=ja:宇江城城跡 |trans-title=Uegusuku Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=30 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.37696201|N|126.77013595|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uegusuku Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/00003648 ] |- | align="center"|[[Uzahama Site]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:宇佐浜遺跡|宇佐浜遺跡]]}}
''Uzahama iseki'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Kunigami, Okinawa|Kunigami]] || [[:en:Yayoi period|Yayoi]] site on the northern tip of the island{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/db/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=192272 |script-title=ja:宇佐浜遺跡 |trans-title=Uzahama Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20120708014450/http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/db/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=192272 |archivedate=8 July 2012 }} || || {{coord|26.86602391|N|128.26020475|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Uzahama Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3016 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Urasoe Castle|Urasoe Castle]] Site
{{nihongo2|浦添城跡}}
''Urazoe-jō ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Urasoe, Okinawa|Urasoe]] || fortifications date back to C13/C14; incurred heavy damage during the Battle of Okinawa{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=206923 |script-title=ja:浦添城跡 |trans-title=Urazoe Castle Site |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Urasoe Castle Walls.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.24648788|N|127.73227642|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Urazoe Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3067 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Enkaku-ji (Okinawa)|Enkaku-ji]] Site
{{nihongo2|円覚寺跡}}
''Enkaku-ji ato'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Naha, Okinawa|Naha]] || founded in 1492 by [[Shō Shin]]; the wooden temple buildings were destroyed during the war, an ornately carved stone bridge ([[:en:List of Important Cultural Properties of Japan (Okinawa: structures)|ICP]]) survives{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=196300 |script-title=ja:旧円覚寺放生橋 |trans-title=Engaku-ji Hōjō Bridge |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || [[File:Enkaku-ji(Shuri)200703.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.21832884|N|127.71963726|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Enkakuji Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|3]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3026 ] |- | align="center"|[[Ogidō Shell Mound]]
{{nihongo2|[[:ja:荻堂貝塚|荻堂貝塚]]}}
''Ogidō kaizuka'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Kitanakagusuku, Okinawa|Kitanakagusuku]] || [[Jōmon period]], with a 1.2 m thick deposit of shells{{cite web |url=http://bunka.nii.ac.jp/SearchDetail.do?heritageId=162738 |script-title=ja:荻堂貝塚 |trans-title=Ogidō Shell Mound |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=31 May 2012}} || || {{coord|26.29323453|N|127.79865309|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Ogidō Shell Mound}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|1]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3022 ] |- | align="center"|[[Shimotabaru Castle]] Site

''Shimotabaru-jō ato'' || [[:en:Hateruma|Hateruma Island]] || [[:en:Taketomi, Okinawa|Taketomi]] || || [[File:2016-02-26 Shimotabaru-jou,Hateruma 下田原城・ぶりぶち公園 波照間島 DSCF2525.JPG|150px]] || {{coord|24.06934384|N|123.77915508|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Shimotabaru Castle Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3366 ] |- | align="center"|[[:en:Tamagusuku Castle|Tamagusuku Castle]] Site

''Tamaudun'' || [[:en:Okinawa Island|Okinawa Island]] || [[:en:Naha, Okinawa|Naha]] || royal mausoleum complex constructed in 1501; [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu|World Heritage Site]] || [[File:Tamaudun03bs3200.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|26.21831078|N|127.71465507|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Tamaudūn}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|7]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3027 ] |- | align="center"|[[Kushibaru Shell Mound]]

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of '''[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]]'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and [[:en:Ryukyu Islands|Islands]] was destroyed during the [[:en:Battle of Okinawa|Battle of Okinawa]]. The mausoleum complex of [[:en:Tamaudun|Tamaudun]], [[:en:Shuri Castle|Shuri Castle]], [[:en:Katsuren Castle|Katsuren Castle]], [[:en:Nakagusuku Castle|Nakagusuku Castle]], [[:en:Nakijin Castle|Nakijin Castle]], [[:en:Zakimi Castle|Zakimi Castle]], [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]] all form part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu]].{{cite web |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/972/ |title=Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |accessdate=24 September 2017}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 October 2024, forty-three Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]].{{cite web {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of '''[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]]'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and [[:en:Ryukyu Islands|Islands]] was destroyed during the [[:en:Battle of Okinawa|Battle of Okinawa]]. The mausoleum complex of [[:en:Tamaudun|Tamaudun]], [[:en:Shuri Castle|Shuri Castle]], [[:en:Katsuren Castle|Katsuren Castle]], [[:en:Nakagusuku Castle|Nakagusuku Castle]], [[:en:Nakijin Castle|Nakijin Castle]], [[:en:Zakimi Castle|Zakimi Castle]], [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]] all form part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu]].{{cite web |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/972/ |title=Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |accessdate=24 September 2017}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 October 2024, forty-three Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 October 2024 |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 沖縄県) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.okinawa.jp/kyoiku/edu/1008462/1008471/1028479.html |script-title=ja:国・県・市町村指定文化財 |trans-title=National, Prefectural, and Municipal Cultural Properties |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa Prefecture]] |date=1 May 2024
