[[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Okinawa)]] [[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Okinawa)]] [[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Okinawa)]] {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the {{ill|Prefectures of Japan|en|Prefectures of Japan|qid=Q50337|lt=Prefecture|1=Prefectures of Japan}} of '''{{ill|Okinawa Prefecture|en|Okinawa Prefecture|qid=Q766445|lt=Okinawa|1=Okinawa Prefecture}}'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and {{ill|Ryukyu Islands|en|Ryukyu Islands|qid=Q6897416|lt=Islands|1=Ryukyu Islands}} was destroyed during the {{ill|Battle of Okinawa|en|Battle of Okinawa|qid=Q192660|lt=Battle of Okinawa|1=Battle of Okinawa}}. The mausoleum complex of {{ill|Tamaudun|en|Tamaudun|qid=Q1186324|lt=Tamaudun|1=Tamaudun}}, {{ill|Shuri Castle|en|Shuri Castle|qid=Q907052|lt=Shuri Castle|1=Shuri Castle}}, {{ill|Katsuren Castle|en|Katsuren Castle|qid=Q2471589|lt=Katsuren Castle|1=Katsuren Castle}}, {{ill|Nakagusuku Castle|en|Nakagusuku Castle|qid=Q1013209|lt=Nakagusuku Castle|1=Nakagusuku Castle}}, {{ill|Nakijin Castle|en|Nakijin Castle|qid=Q508866|lt=Nakijin Castle|1=Nakijin Castle}}, {{ill|Zakimi Castle|en|Zakimi Castle|qid=Q2338956|lt=Zakimi Castle|1=Zakimi Castle}}, [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]] all form part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site [[Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu]].{{cite web |url=https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/972/ |title=Gusuku Sites and Related Properties of the Kingdom of Ryukyu |publisher=[[UNESCO]] |accessdate=24 September 2017}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 1 October 2024, forty-three Sites have been {{ill|Cultural Property (Japan)|en|Cultural Property (Japan)|qid=Q858308|lt=designated|1=Cultural Property (Japan)}} as being of national {{ill|Values (heritage)|en|Values (heritage)|qid=Q7912786|lt=significance|1=Values (heritage)}}.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese ''Furusutobaru iseki'' || {{ill|Ishigaki Island|en|Ishigaki Island|qid=Q714339|lt=Ishigaki Island|1=Ishigaki Island}} || {{ill|Ishigaki, Okinawa|en|Ishigaki, Okinawa|qid=Q838366|lt=Ishigaki|1=Ishigaki, Okinawa}} || C13-C15 {{ill|Gusuku|en|Gusuku|qid=Q1044204|lt=Gusuku|1=Gusuku}}-style fortifications, domestic buildings, [[utaki]], and tombs extending for 12.3 ha on the {{nihongo|Ryūkyū limestone|[[:ja:琉球石灰岩|琉球石灰岩]]}} hills overlooking Miyara Bay; said to have been used by {{ill|Oyake Akahachi|en|Oyake Akahachi|qid=Q845103|lt=Oyake Akahachi|1=Oyake Akahachi}} and suppressed by the forces of {{ill|Shō Shin|en|Shō Shin|qid=Q281765|lt=Shō Shin|1=Shō Shin}} in 1500; finds include local pottery, white porcelain and {{ill|Celadon|en|Celadon|qid=Q1054559|lt=Celadon|1=Celadon}} from China, and the bones of horses and cows{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okinawa.jp/shin-ishigaki/yougo/furusuto.html |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡 |trans-title=Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher={{ill|Okinawa Prefecture|en|Okinawa Prefecture|qid=Q766445|lt=Okinawa Prefecture|1=Okinawa Prefecture}} |accessdate=30 May 2012}}{{cite web |url=http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |script-title=ja:フルスト原遺跡の概要 |trans-title=Overview of the Furusutobaru Site |language=Japanese |publisher={{ill|Ishigaki, Okinawa|en|Ishigaki, Okinawa|qid=Q838366|lt=Ishigaki City|1=Ishigaki, Okinawa}} |accessdate=30 May 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070502130351/http://www.city.ishigaki.okinawa.jp/400000/410000/410400/bunkaka/furusutobaru.htm |archivedate=2 May 2007 }} || [[File:Ishigaki furusutobaru iseki.jpg|150px]] || {{coord|24.3511203|N|124.19500445|E|display=inline|format=dms|type:landmark_region:JP_scale:10000|name=Furusutobaru Site}} || [[Monuments of Japan#Historic Sites and Special Historic Sites|2]] || [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/3059 ] |- | align="center"|{{ill|Agena Castle|en|Agena Castle|qid=Q30926451|lt=Agena Castle|1=Agena Castle}} Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''[[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]]''' located within the {{ill|Prefectures of Japan|en|Prefectures of Japan|qid=Q50337|lt=Prefecture|1=Prefectures of Japan}} of '''{{ill|Okinawa Prefecture|en|Okinawa Prefecture|qid=Q766445|lt=Okinawa|1=Okinawa Prefecture}}'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=24 October 2024}} Much of the heritage of the [[:en:Ryūkyū Kingdom|Ryūkyū Kingdom]] and {{ill|Ryukyu Islands|en|Ryukyu Islands|qid=Q6897416|lt=Islands|1=Ryukyu Islands}} was destroyed during the {{ill|Battle of Okinawa|en|Battle of Okinawa|qid=Q192660|lt=Battle of Okinawa|1=Battle of Okinawa}}. The mausoleum complex of {{ill|Tamaudun|en|Tamaudun|qid=Q1186324|lt=Tamaudun|1=Tamaudun}}, {{ill|Shuri Castle|en|Shuri Castle|qid=Q907052|lt=Shuri Castle|1=Shuri Castle}}, {{ill|Katsuren Castle|en|Katsuren Castle|qid=Q2471589|lt=Katsuren Castle|1=Katsuren Castle}}, {{ill|Nakagusuku Castle|en|Nakagusuku Castle|qid=Q1013209|lt=Nakagusuku Castle|1=Nakagusuku Castle}}, {{ill|Nakijin Castle|en|Nakijin Castle|qid=Q508866|lt=Nakijin Castle|1=Nakijin Castle}}, {{ill|Zakimi Castle|en|Zakimi Castle|qid=Q2338956|lt=Zakimi Castle|1=Zakimi Castle}}, [[Sefa-utaki]], and [[Sonohyan-utaki]]
